evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jeline: 'I'm just gonna ask you questions regarding this to give you an estimate and this could take ten to fifteen minutes. So is this a good time to talk about the move?' — time-boxed but no explicit promise of dependable quote, and customer immediately requests callback without clear yes.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Jeline confirms pickup address (10402 town and country way Houston 77024), property type/size (two bedroom apartment, 1000 sq ft), destination (222651 rice flower way park pro Texas 77449, 2000 sq feet two story house), and moving date (November 16th — stated in Jeline's opening). All four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing (elevator access, hallway distance, special items) without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (apartment/house), floors/stories (7th floor apartment, 2-story house), rooms (2 bedrooms), walking distance (50-100 feet hallway), elevator access (freight elevator confirmed), special considerations (65-inch TV, no large appliances/equipment), parking (street parking at destination, driveway too small). Comprehensive.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep discussed boxes and box counts but never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'normally we see 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Customer confirmed yes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor provided with personalization: '$192 per hour for two movers' plus travel fee; minimum 2.5 hours; then personalized: 'since we're coming from a 74 with the reserve elevator and the long walk going to a two story house I estimate the move to finish in four and a half to five and a half hours. Estimated cost for this move is $934 to $1,126.' Also provided secondary partial-move estimate: 'two and a half to three hours...if ever two and a half that's $550 to $646.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full framing delivered: Trip fee disclosed ($70, one-time), explicitly no heat fees, no credit card fees, no other hidden fees; minimum 2.5 hours stated; 15-minute increment prorating explained ('the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments'). All elements present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from estimate to 'But of course Raj this is only my yes for moving everything' and then to partial-move discussion without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or waiting for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Never mentioned. No reference to On-Time Guarantee or discount terms for lateness.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Partial delivery. Mentioned: 'if ever there are any damages or even small scratch you can report it to us and then we do have an additional coverage that can cover you up to $2,000 per move.' Coverage amount and no-deductible framing present ('No sir, it's already included on the hourly rate. No need for you to pay extra for that'). Missing: explicit 'no fine print' framing and stronger emphasis on the 'built in' nature.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar closing question after damage coverage explanation.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway version. Rep asks only 'Do you have any questions?' — the empty/automatic question that gets a reflexive no, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variant.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Instead, transitions directly to 'Alright, kindly wait for the email that I'll be sending' without securing the booking.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate lock or deposit; only a discussion of date-dependent pricing (Mon-Thu vs Fri-Sat).
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No booking details confirmed: date is assumed (November 16th mentioned by customer in original request, not re-confirmed), no phone confirmed, no arrival window set, no crew size agreed, no addresses re-confirmed with customer explicitly, no notes left for crew about customer concerns (TV size noted internally but not framed as crew notes).

top_strength: Jeline gathered logistics details thoroughly and systematically—property types, floor access, special items, TV size, box counts—and personalized the estimate to the specific move profile (elevator reservation, hallway distance, two-story destination).
coaching_note: End the call with an explicit ask for the business ('Would you like our help with your move?') and confirm booking details (date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses) before hanging up—right now the call ends with an email send-off and no booking secured.
